name: sgd_step
summary: SGD parameter update: O = P - lr * G. Inputs: (param_in, grad), Output: (param_out). Any-rank contiguous tensors flattened to numel. Allows in-place (O may alias P). Forbids O aliasing G. AttrBlob optionally provides lr (schema 'SGDS'); schema_id==0 uses default lr.
contract: Inputs: 2 tensors: P(param_in), G(grad). Outputs: 1 tensor: O(param_out).
Shape: P, G, O must have same rank (>=1) and identical shape.
Layout: P, G, O must be contiguous (TensorDesc.contiguous==true).
abi: payload for 'SGDS': float32 lr, Python: struct.pack('<f', lr).

variants.name: sgd_step_f32
notes: Reads lr from AttrBlob (SGDS) else default.

variants.name: sgd_step_f16
notes: Scalar half: converts to float, updates, stores half.

variants.name: sgd_step_f16_half2
variants.launch: grid-stride on half2 lanes, threads=256, blocks=min(65535, ceil_div(numel/2,256))
notes: half2 path still does float2 math (via __half22float2).
If you later want max throughput: switch to half2 FMA-style ops (hmul2/hsub2) with lr packed to half2, but accuracy changes.

suites.name: correctness
suites.desc: Match reference O = P - lr*G including in-place update.

suites.name: half2_gating
suites.desc: Ensure half2 selected only when safe.

cases.notes: Force misalignment on one pointer (e.g., slice offset).

experiments.title: half2 math vs float2 in half2 path
experiments.change: Replace __half22float2 + floats2half2 with native half2 ops using lr2=__float2half2_rn(lr): out2 = __hsub2(p2, __hmul2(lr2,g2)).
experiments.tradeoff: Faster, but uses half precision multiply/sub; may increase update error for large grads or lr.
